````
1. # Frontend Structure for Next.js
2. 
3. This folder is reserved for the Next.js frontend of the WebGIS system.
4. 
5. ## Design Goals
6. 
7. - Use Next.js App Router.
8. - Keep UI, feature logic, and shared utilities separated.
9. - Organize code by domain: map, stations, weather, hydrology, alerts, reports, admin.
10. - Prefer server/client boundaries explicitly instead of mixing everything in page files.
11. - Keep reusable UI in `components` and business-facing logic in `features`.
12. 
13. ## Recommended Structure
14. 
15. ```text
16. frontend/
17. ├── public/
18. ├── src/
19. │   ├── app/
20. │   │   ├── (public)/
21. │   │   ├── (dashboard)/
22. │   │   └── api/
23. │   ├── components/
24. │   │   ├── ui/
25. │   │   ├── layout/
26. │   │   └── map/
27. │   ├── features/
28. │   │   ├── auth/
29. │   │   ├── map/
30. │   │   ├── stations/
31. │   │   ├── weather/
32. │   │   ├── hydrology/
33. │   │   ├── alerts/
34. │   │   ├── reports/
35. │   │   └── admin/
36. │   ├── lib/
37. │   │   ├── api/
38. │   │   ├── constants/
39. │   │   ├── utils/
40. │   │   └── validations/
41. │   ├── hooks/
42. │   ├── types/
43. │   └── styles/
44. │       └── theme/
45. └── README.md
46. ```
47. 
48. ## Folder Responsibilities
49. 
50. - `src/app`: route structure, layouts, pages, loading/error boundaries, API routes.
51. - `src/components/ui`: pure reusable UI components.
52. - `src/components/layout`: shell components such as header, sidebar, shell, navbar.
53. - `src/components/map`: map-only visual building blocks.
54. - `src/features`: domain modules that own state, data fetching, and feature logic.
55. - `src/lib/api`: API client, request wrappers, endpoint helpers.
56. - `src/lib/constants`: shared constants and enum-like values.
57. - `src/lib/utils`: generic helper functions.
58. - `src/lib/validations`: schema validation and form rules.
59. - `src/hooks`: reusable React hooks.
60. - `src/types`: shared TypeScript types and interfaces.
61. - `src/styles`: global styles, design tokens, theme primitives.
62. 
63. ## Route Grouping Suggestion
64. 
65. - `(public)`: landing page, login, public map view, public reports if needed.
66. - `(dashboard)`: authenticated dashboard, monitoring screens, admin screens.
67. - `api`: server-side route handlers used by the frontend when needed.
68. 
69. ## Implementation Rules
70. 
71. - Keep feature code inside `features`, not inside `app`.
72. - Keep presentation components dumb and reusable.
73. - Keep map-specific code isolated so it does not leak into unrelated screens.
74. - Avoid putting API calls directly in page components when the logic belongs to a feature module.
75. - Prefer typed service functions and typed responses from the start.
76. 
77. ## Next Step
78. 
79. When the actual Next.js project is initialized, add the standard root files such as `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `next.config.js`, `eslint.config.*`, `src/app/layout.tsx`, and `src/app/globals.css` according to this structure.
80. 
81. ## Current Setup
82. 
83. - Install dependencies with `npm install`.
84. - Start development server with `npm run dev` on port `4001`.
85. - Build production bundle with `npm run build`.
86. - Run type check with `npm run typecheck`.
87.
````

</details>

5. function escapeCsvValue(value) {
6.   if (value === null || value === undefined) {
7.     return '';
8.   }
9. 
10.   const text = value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value);
11. 
12.   if (/[",\r\n]/.test(text)) {
13.     return `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
14.   }
15. 
16.   return text;
17. }
18. 
19. function collectColumns(rows) {
20.   const columns = [];
21.   const seen = new Set();
22. 
23.   for (const row of rows) {
24.     for (const key of Object.keys(row)) {
25.       if (!seen.has(key)) {
26.         seen.add(key);
27.         columns.push(key);
28.       }
29.     }
30.   }
31. 
32.   return columns;
33. }
34. 
35. function quoteIdentifier(identifier) {
36.   return `\`${String(identifier).replaceAll('`', '``')}\``;
37. }
38. 
39. function normalizeMysqlValue(value) {
40.   if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
41.     return null;
42.   }
43. 
44.   if (value instanceof Date) {
45.     return value.toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ');
46.   }
47. 
48.   if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
49.     return value ? 1 : 0;
50.   }
51. 
52.   if (typeof value === 'object') {
53.     return JSON.stringify(value);
54.   }
55. 
56.   return value;
57. }
58. 
59. export function formatMysqlDateTime(date = new Date()) {
60.   return date.toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ');
61. }
62. 
63. function normalizeColumnName(name) {
64.   const normalized = String(name)
65.     .trim()
66.     .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, '_')
67.     .replace(/_+/g, '_')
68.     .replace(/^([0-9])/, '_$1');
69. 
70.   return normalized || 'column';
71. }

73. export function buildCsvContent(rows, columns = collectColumns(rows)) {
74.   if (!rows.length) {
75.     return '';
76.   }
77. 
78.   const headerColumns = columns.length ? columns : collectColumns(rows);
79.   const lines = [headerColumns.map(escapeCsvValue).join(',')];
80. 
81.   for (const row of rows) {
82.     lines.push(headerColumns.map((column) => escapeCsvValue(row[column])).join(','));
83.   }
84. 
85.   return lines.join('\n');
86. }

88. export async function writeCsvSnapshot(csvPath, rows, columns) {
89.   const absolutePath = resolve(csvPath);
90.   await mkdir(dirname(absolutePath), { recursive: true });
91. 
92.   const csvContent = buildCsvContent(rows, columns);
93.   await writeFile(absolutePath, csvContent ? `${csvContent}\n` : '', 'utf8');
94. 
95.   return absolutePath;

98. function buildColumnDefinitionSql(column) {
99.   return `${quoteIdentifier(column.name)} ${column.type}`;
100. }
101. 
102. function buildUniqueKeySql(uniqueKeyColumns = []) {
103.   if (!uniqueKeyColumns.length) {
104.     return '';
105.   }
106. 
107.   const uniqueName = `uniq_${uniqueKeyColumns.join('_')}`;
108.   const quotedColumns = uniqueKeyColumns.map(quoteIdentifier).join(', ');
109.   return `UNIQUE KEY ${quoteIdentifier(uniqueName)} (${quotedColumns})`;
110. }
111. 
112. async function ensureMysqlTable(connection, databaseName, tableName, columnDefinitions, uniqueKeyColumns = []) {
113.   await connection.query(
114.     `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ${quoteIdentifier(databaseName)} CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci`,
115.   );
116.   await connection.query(`USE ${quoteIdentifier(databaseName)}`);
117. 
118.   const [existingColumns] = await connection.query(
119.     `SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND TABLE_NAME = ?`,
120.     [databaseName, tableName],
121.   );
122. 
123.   const existingColumnNames = new Set(existingColumns.map((row) => row.COLUMN_NAME));
124. 
125.   if (existingColumnNames.size === 0) {
126.     const createColumns = [
127.       '`id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT',
128.       ...columnDefinitions.map(buildColumnDefinitionSql),
129.       ...(uniqueKeyColumns.length ? [buildUniqueKeySql(uniqueKeyColumns)] : []),
130.       'PRIMARY KEY (`id`)',
131.     ].join(',\n  ');
132. 
133.     await connection.query(
134.       `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${quoteIdentifier(tableName)} (\n  ${createColumns}\n) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci`,
135.     );
136.     return;
137.   }
138. 
139.   for (const column of columnDefinitions) {
140.     if (!existingColumnNames.has(column.name)) {
141.       await connection.query(`ALTER TABLE ${quoteIdentifier(tableName)} ADD COLUMN ${buildColumnDefinitionSql(column)}`);
142.     }
143.   }
144. }
145. 
146. function buildInsertSql(tableName, columnNames, rowCount) {
147.   const rowPlaceholders = `(${columnNames.map(() => '?').join(', ')})`;
148.   const allPlaceholders = Array.from({ length: rowCount }, () => rowPlaceholders).join(', ');
149.   const quotedColumns = columnNames.map(quoteIdentifier).join(', ');
150. 
151.   return `INSERT INTO ${quoteIdentifier(tableName)} (${quotedColumns}) VALUES ${allPlaceholders}`;
152. }
153. 
154. export async function syncRowsToMysql({
155.   mysqlConfig,
156.   databaseName,
157.   tableName,
158.   rows,
159.   columnDefinitions,
160.   uniqueKeyColumns = [],
161.   batchSize = 200,
162. }) {
163.   if (!rows.length) {
164.     return { insertedRows: 0 };
165.   }
166. 
167.   const { database: _ignoredDatabase, ...connectionConfig } = mysqlConfig || {};
168.   const connection = await mysql.createConnection(connectionConfig);
169. 
170.   try {
171.     await ensureMysqlTable(connection, databaseName, tableName, columnDefinitions, uniqueKeyColumns);
172. 
173.     const columnNames = columnDefinitions.map((column) => column.name);
174.     let insertedRows = 0;
175. 
176.     for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += batchSize) {
177.       const batch = rows.slice(index, index + batchSize);
178.       const sql = buildInsertSql(tableName, columnNames, batch.length);
179.       const values = batch.flatMap((row) => columnNames.map((columnName) => normalizeMysqlValue(row[columnName])));
180.       await connection.query(sql, values);
181.       insertedRows += batch.length;
182.     }
183. 
184.     return { insertedRows };
185.   } finally {
186.     await connection.end();
187.   }
188. }
189. 
190. function buildUpsertSql(tableName, columnNames, updateColumnNames, rowCount) {
191.   const insertSql = buildInsertSql(tableName, columnNames, rowCount);
192.   const updates = updateColumnNames.map((columnName) => `${quoteIdentifier(columnName)} = VALUES(${quoteIdentifier(columnName)})`).join(', ');
193.   return `${insertSql} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ${updates}`;
194. }
195. 
196. export async function upsertRowsToMysql({
197.   mysqlConfig,
198.   databaseName,
199.   tableName,
200.   rows,
201.   columnDefinitions,
202.   uniqueKeyColumns = [],
203.   updateColumnNames = null,
204.   batchSize = 200,
205. }) {
206.   if (!rows.length) {
207.     return { affectedRows: 0 };
208.   }
209. 
210.   const { database: _ignoredDatabase, ...connectionConfig } = mysqlConfig || {};
211.   const connection = await mysql.createConnection(connectionConfig);
212. 
213.   try {
214.     await ensureMysqlTable(connection, databaseName, tableName, columnDefinitions, uniqueKeyColumns);
215. 
216.     const columnNames = columnDefinitions.map((column) => column.name);
217.     const resolvedUpdateColumns = updateColumnNames || columnNames.filter((columnName) => !uniqueKeyColumns.includes(columnName));
218.     let affectedRows = 0;
219. 
220.     for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += batchSize) {
221.       const batch = rows.slice(index, index + batchSize);
222.       const sql = buildUpsertSql(tableName, columnNames, resolvedUpdateColumns, batch.length);
223.       const values = batch.flatMap((row) => columnNames.map((columnName) => normalizeMysqlValue(row[columnName])));
224.       const [result] = await connection.query(sql, values);
225.       affectedRows += Number(result?.affectedRows || 0);
226.     }
227. 
228.     return { affectedRows };
229.   } finally {
230.     await connection.end();
231.   }
232. }

254.     const params = [dateValue, ...whereParams];
255.     const [result] = await connection.query(sql, params);

319. async function loginCustomer(config) {
320.   const encryptedPassword = encryptPassword(config.username, config.password);
321.   
322.   const payload = new URLSearchParams({
323.     Timezone: config.timezone,
324.     Username: config.username,
325.     Password: encryptedPassword,
326.     AppCode: config.appCode,
327.     deviceuuid: config.deviceUuid,
328.     DeviceInfo: config.deviceInfo,
329.   });
330. 
331.   const loginMethod = config.loginMethod.toUpperCase();
332.   const loginUrl =
333.     loginMethod === 'GET' ? buildUrl(config.loginUrl, Object.fromEntries(payload.entries())) : config.loginUrl;
334. 
335.   const response = await fetch(loginUrl, {
336.     method: loginMethod,
337.     headers: {
338.       Accept: 'application/json, text/plain, */*',
339.       'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
340.     },
341.     body: loginMethod === 'GET' ? undefined : payload,
342.   });
343. 
344.   const body = await readResponseBody(response);
345. 
346.   if (!response.ok) {
347.     throw new Error(
348.       `Login failed (${response.status} ${response.statusText}). The account may require an encrypted password instead of plaintext, or the credentials/device payload may be invalid: ${stringifyBody(body)}`,
349.     );
350.   }
351. 
352.   const token = extractToken(body);
353.   if (!token) {
354.     throw new Error(`Login response did not contain a token: ${stringifyBody(body)}`);
355.   }
356. 
357.   const customerCode = findStringByKey(body, 'CustomerCode') || config.customerCode;
358. 
359.   return { token, customerCode };
360. }

302.   const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
303. 
304.   if (args.help) {
305.     printUsage();
306.     return;
307.   }
308. 
309.   let cookie = args.cookie || LOGIN_COOKIE;
310. 
311.   if (!cookie && args.cookieFile) {
312.     cookie = await readCookieFile(String(args.cookieFile));
313.   }
314. 
315.   const loginPayload = {
316.     account: args.account || DEFAULT_LOGIN_PAYLOAD.account,
317.     password: args.password || DEFAULT_LOGIN_PAYLOAD.password,
318.     authorize: args.authorize !== undefined ? String(args.authorize) : DEFAULT_LOGIN_PAYLOAD.authorize,
319.   };
320. 
321.   const shouldLogin = Boolean(loginPayload.account && loginPayload.password);
322. 
323.   if (!cookie && args.bootstrap !== false && !shouldLogin) {
324.     cookie = await bootstrapCookies();
325.   }
326. 
327.   let loginResult = null;
328.   if (shouldLogin) {
329.     loginResult = await loginEcowitt(loginPayload, cookie);
330.     cookie = loginResult.cookie;
331.   }
332. 
333.   const payload = {
334.     ...DEFAULT_PAYLOAD,
335.     ...(args.deviceId ? { device_id: String(args.deviceId) } : {}),
336.     ...(args.isList ? { is_list: String(args.isList) } : {}),
337.     ...(args.mode ? { mode: String(args.mode) } : {}),
338.     ...(args.sdate ? { sdate: String(args.sdate) } : {}),
339.     ...(args.edate ? { edate: String(args.edate) } : {}),
340.     ...(args.page ? { page: String(args.page) } : {}),
341.     ...(args.sortList ? { sortList: String(args.sortList) } : {}),
342.     ...(args.hideList !== undefined ? { hideList: String(args.hideList) } : {}),
343.   };
344. 
345.   const requestPath = '/index/get_data';
346.   const body = buildRequestBody(payload, requestPath);
347. 
348.   const response = await fetch('https://www.ecowitt.net/index/get_data', {
349.     method: 'POST',
350.     headers: {
351.       Accept: 'application/json, text/plain, */*',
352.       'Accept-EcowittLang': 'en',
353.       'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
354.       'Web-Version': '1',
355.       ...(cookie ? { Cookie: cookie } : {}),
356.     },
357.     body,
358.   });
359. 
360.   const data = await readBody(response);
361. 
362.   if (!response.ok) {
363.     throw new Error(`Ecowitt request failed (${response.status} ${response.statusText}): ${stringify(data)}`);
364.   }
365. 
366.   if (data && typeof data === 'object' && 'errcode' in data && String(data.errcode) !== '0') {
367.     throw new Error(`Ecowitt returned ${String(data.errcode)}: ${stringify(data)}`);
368.   }
369. 
370.   const output = {
371.     login: loginResult,
372.     request: payload,
373.     data,
374.   };
375. 
376.   const fetchedAt = formatMysqlDateTime();
377.   const rows = buildEcowittRows(data, fetchedAt);
378.   const csvPath = buildCsvPath(args.output);
379.   const csvColumns = collectRowColumns(rows);
380. 
381.   await writeCsvSnapshot(csvPath, rows, csvColumns);
382. 
383.   if (rows.length) {
384.     const columnDefinitions = buildEcowittColumnDefinitions(rows);
385.     const mysqlRows = remapRowsForMysql(rows, columnDefinitions);
386. 
387.     await syncRowsToMysql({
388.       mysqlConfig: MYSQL_CONFIG,
389.       databaseName: MYSQL_CONFIG.database,
390.       tableName: 'ecowitt',
391.       rows: mysqlRows,
392.       columnDefinitions,
393.     });
394.   }
395. 
396.   if (args.output) {
397.     const absolutePath = resolve(process.cwd(), String(args.output));
398.     await mkdir(dirname(absolutePath), { recursive: true });
399.     await writeFile(absolutePath, JSON.stringify(output, null, 2), 'utf8');
400.   }
401. 
402.   console.log(JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));
403. }
404. 
405. main().catch((error) => {
406.   console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
407.   process.exit(1);
408. });
409.
```

</details>

1. package com.mekongsaltlab.org.service;
2. 
3. import com.mekongsaltlab.org.dto.AuthResponse;
4. import com.mekongsaltlab.org.dto.LoginRequest;
5. import com.mekongsaltlab.org.dto.RegisterRequest;
6. import com.mekongsaltlab.org.entity.User;

8. import com.mekongsaltlab.org.security.JwtUtil;
9. import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
10. import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
11. import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
12. import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
13. import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
14. 
15. @Service
16. @RequiredArgsConstructor
17. public class AuthService {
18.     
19.     private final UserRepository userRepository;
20.     private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
21.     private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
22.     private final AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;
23.     
24.     public AuthResponse register(RegisterRequest request) {
25.         if (userRepository.existsByUsername(request.getUsername())) {
26.             throw new RuntimeException("Username already exists");
27.         }
28.         if (userRepository.existsByEmail(request.getEmail())) {
29.             throw new RuntimeException("Email already exists");
30.         }
31.         
32.         User user = new User();
33.         user.setUsername(request.getUsername());
34.         user.setEmail(request.getEmail());
35.         user.setPassword(passwordEncoder.encode(request.getPassword()));
36.         
37.         userRepository.save(user);
38.         
39.         String token = jwtUtil.generateToken(user);
40.         return new AuthResponse(token, user.getUsername(), user.getEmail(), user.getRole().name());
41.     }
42.     
43.     public AuthResponse login(LoginRequest request) {
44.         authenticationManager.authenticate(
45.                 new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(request.getUsername(), request.getPassword())
46.         );
47.         
48.         User user = userRepository.findByUsername(request.getUsername())
49.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("User not found"));
50.         
51.         String token = jwtUtil.generateToken(user);
52.         return new AuthResponse(token, user.getUsername(), user.getEmail(), user.getRole().name());
53.     }
54. }
55.

1. package com.mekongsaltlab.org.service;
2. 
3. import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
4. import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
5. import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;

9. import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Client;
10. import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.model.*;
11. 
12. import java.io.IOException;
13. import java.io.InputStream;
14. import java.time.LocalDateTime;
15. import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
16. import java.util.List;
17. import java.util.stream.Collectors;
18. 
19. @Service
20. @RequiredArgsConstructor
21. @Slf4j
22. public class S3Service {
23.     
24.     private final S3Client s3Client;
25.     
26.     @Value("${s3.bucket}")
27.     private String bucketName;
28.     
29.     /**
30.      * Upload file to S3
31.      */
32.     public String uploadFile(String key, MultipartFile file) throws IOException {
33.         try {
34.             PutObjectRequest putObjectRequest = PutObjectRequest.builder()
35.                     .bucket(bucketName)
36.                     .key(key)
37.                     .contentType(file.getContentType())
38.                     .build();
39.             
40.             s3Client.putObject(putObjectRequest, RequestBody.fromInputStream(file.getInputStream(), file.getSize()));
41.             
42.             log.info("Uploaded file to S3: {}", key);
43.             return key;
44.         } catch (S3Exception e) {
45.             log.error("Failed to upload file to S3: {}", e.getMessage());
46.             throw new RuntimeException("Failed to upload file: " + e.getMessage());
47.         }
48.     }
49.     
50.     /**
51.      * Upload file with auto-generated key (timestamp-based)
52.      */
53.     public String uploadFile(MultipartFile file) throws IOException {
54.         String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
55.         String originalFilename = file.getOriginalFilename();
56.         String key = String.format("uploads/%s_%s", timestamp, originalFilename);
57.         return uploadFile(key, file);
58.     }
59.     
60.     /**
61.      * Upload file from InputStream (for backup service)
62.      */
63.     public String uploadFile(String key, InputStream inputStream, long contentLength) {
64.         try {
65.             PutObjectRequest putObjectRequest = PutObjectRequest.builder()
66.                     .bucket(bucketName)
67.                     .key(key)
68.                     .build();
69.             
70.             s3Client.putObject(putObjectRequest, RequestBody.fromInputStream(inputStream, contentLength));
71.             
72.             log.info("Uploaded file to S3: {}", key);
73.             return key;
74.         } catch (S3Exception e) {
75.             log.error("Failed to upload file to S3: {}", e.getMessage());
76.             throw new RuntimeException("Failed to upload file: " + e.getMessage());
77.         }
78.     }
79.     
80.     /**
81.      * Download file from S3
82.      */
83.     public InputStream downloadFile(String key) {
84.         try {
85.             GetObjectRequest getObjectRequest = GetObjectRequest.builder()
86.                     .bucket(bucketName)
87.                     .key(key)
88.                     .build();
89.             
90.             return s3Client.getObject(getObjectRequest);
91.         } catch (S3Exception e) {
92.             log.error("Failed to download file from S3: {}", e.getMessage());
93.             throw new RuntimeException("Failed to download file: " + e.getMessage());
94.         }
95.     }
96.     
97.     /**
98.      * Delete file from S3
99.      */
100.     public void deleteFile(String key) {
101.         try {
102.             DeleteObjectRequest deleteObjectRequest = DeleteObjectRequest.builder()
103.                     .bucket(bucketName)
104.                     .key(key)
105.                     .build();
106.             
107.             s3Client.deleteObject(deleteObjectRequest);
108.             log.info("Deleted file from S3: {}", key);
109.         } catch (S3Exception e) {
110.             log.error("Failed to delete file from S3: {}", e.getMessage());
111.             throw new RuntimeException("Failed to delete file: " + e.getMessage());
112.         }
113.     }
114.     
115.     /**
116.      * List files in S3 bucket
117.      */
118.     public List<String> listFiles(String prefix) {
119.         try {
120.             ListObjectsV2Request listRequest = ListObjectsV2Request.builder()
121.                     .bucket(bucketName)
122.                     .prefix(prefix)
123.                     .build();
124.             
125.             ListObjectsV2Response listResponse = s3Client.listObjectsV2(listRequest);
126.             
127.             return listResponse.contents().stream()
128.                     .map(S3Object::key)
129.                     .collect(Collectors.toList());
130.         } catch (S3Exception e) {
131.             log.error("Failed to list files from S3: {}", e.getMessage());
132.             throw new RuntimeException("Failed to list files: " + e.getMessage());
133.         }
134.     }
135.     
136.     /**
137.      * Generate file URL
138.      */
139.     public String getFileUrl(String key) {
140.         return String.format("https://backup.hci.vn/%s/%s", bucketName, key);
141.     }
142.     
143.     /**
144.      * Check if file exists
145.      */
146.     public boolean fileExists(String key) {
147.         try {
148.             HeadObjectRequest headObjectRequest = HeadObjectRequest.builder()
149.                     .bucket(bucketName)
150.                     .key(key)
151.                     .build();
152.             
153.             s3Client.headObject(headObjectRequest);
154.             return true;
155.         } catch (NoSuchKeyException e) {
156.             return false;
157.         } catch (S3Exception e) {
158.             log.error("Failed to check file existence: {}", e.getMessage());
159.             return false;
160.         }
161.     }
162. }

1. package com.mekongsaltlab.org.service;
2. 
3. import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
4. import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
5. import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
6. import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
7. import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
8. 
9. import java.io.*;
10. import java.nio.file.Files;
11. import java.nio.file.Path;
12. import java.time.LocalDateTime;
13. import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
14. import java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream;
15. 
16. @Service
17. @RequiredArgsConstructor
18. @Slf4j
19. public class BackupService {
20.     
21.     private final S3Service s3Service;
22.     
23.     @Value("${spring.datasource.url}")
24.     private String dbUrl;
25.     
26.     @Value("${spring.datasource.username}")
27.     private String dbUsername;
28.     
29.     @Value("${spring.datasource.password}")
30.     private String dbPassword;
31.     
32.     /**
33.      * Backup MySQL to S3 every day at 00:00
34.      */
35.     @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 0 * * ?")
36.     public void backupMysqlToS3() {
37.         log.info("Starting MySQL backup to S3...");
38.         
39.         try {
40.             // 1. Export MySQL to SQL file
41.             String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
42.             Path sqlFile = exportMysqlToSql(timestamp);
43.             
44.             // 2. Compress SQL file
45.             Path gzipFile = compressSqlFile(sqlFile);
46.             
47.             // 3. Upload to S3
48.             String s3Key = "backups/mysql/" + timestamp + "_mekong.sql.gz";
49.             uploadFileToS3(s3Key, gzipFile);
50.             
51.             // 4. Cleanup local files
52.             Files.deleteIfExists(sqlFile);
53.             Files.deleteIfExists(gzipFile);
54.             
55.             log.info("MySQL backup completed successfully: {}", s3Key);
56.         } catch (Exception e) {
57.             log.error("Failed to backup MySQL to S3", e);
58.         }
59.     }
60.     
61.     /**
62.      * Export MySQL database to SQL file
63.      */
64.     private Path exportMysqlToSql(String timestamp) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
65.         // Extract database name from JDBC URL
66.         String dbName = extractDatabaseName(dbUrl);
67.         
68.         // Create temp file
69.         Path sqlFile = Files.createTempFile("backup_" + timestamp, ".sql");
70.         
71.         // Build mysqldump command
72.         ProcessBuilder processBuilder = new ProcessBuilder(
73.             "mysqldump",
74.             "-h", "127.0.0.1",
75.             "-u", dbUsername,
76.             "-p" + dbPassword,
77.             "--single-transaction",
78.             "--routines",
79.             "--triggers",
80.             dbName
81.         );
82.         
83.         processBuilder.redirectOutput(sqlFile.toFile());
84.         processBuilder.redirectErrorStream(true);
85.         
86.         Process process = processBuilder.start();
87.         int exitCode = process.waitFor();
88.         
89.         if (exitCode != 0) {
90.             throw new RuntimeException("mysqldump failed with exit code: " + exitCode);
91.         }
92.         
93.         log.info("MySQL exported to: {}", sqlFile);
94.         return sqlFile;
95.     }
96.     
97.     /**
98.      * Compress SQL file with GZIP
99.      */
100.     private Path compressSqlFile(Path sqlFile) throws IOException {
101.         Path gzipFile = Path.of(sqlFile.toString() + ".gz");
102.         
103.         try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(sqlFile.toFile());
104.              FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(gzipFile.toFile());
105.              GZIPOutputStream gzos = new GZIPOutputStream(fos)) {
106.             
107.             byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
108.             int len;
109.             while ((len = fis.read(buffer)) > 0) {
110.                 gzos.write(buffer, 0, len);
111.             }
112.         }
113.         
114.         log.info("SQL file compressed: {}", gzipFile);
115.         return gzipFile;
116.     }
117.     
118.     /**
119.      * Upload file to S3
120.      */
121.     private void uploadFileToS3(String key, Path file) throws IOException {
122.         try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(file.toFile())) {
123.             s3Service.uploadFile(key, fis, Files.size(file));
124.         }
125.         log.info("File uploaded to S3: {}", key);
126.     }
127.     
128.     /**
129.      * Extract database name from JDBC URL
130.      */
131.     private String extractDatabaseName(String jdbcUrl) {
132.         // jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mekong -> mekong
133.         String[] parts = jdbcUrl.split("/");
134.         String dbNameWithParams = parts[parts.length - 1];
135.         return dbNameWithParams.split("\\?")[0];
136.     }
137.     
138.     /**
139.      * Manual backup trigger (for testing or on-demand backup)
140.      */
141.     public String triggerManualBackup() {
142.         try {
143.             String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
144.             Path sqlFile = exportMysqlToSql(timestamp);
145.             Path gzipFile = compressSqlFile(sqlFile);
146.             
147.             String s3Key = "backups/mysql/manual_" + timestamp + "_mekong.sql.gz";
148.             uploadFileToS3(s3Key, gzipFile);
149.             
150.             Files.deleteIfExists(sqlFile);
151.             Files.deleteIfExists(gzipFile);
152.             
153.             return s3Key;
154.         } catch (Exception e) {
155.             log.error("Manual backup failed", e);
156.             throw new RuntimeException("Backup failed: " + e.getMessage());
157.         }
158.     }
159. }
160.
```

1. package com.mekongsaltlab.org.security;
2. 
3. import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
4. import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
5. import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
6. import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
7. import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
8. import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
9. 
10. import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
11. import java.util.Date;
12. import java.util.HashMap;
13. import java.util.Map;
14. import java.util.function.Function;
15. 
16. @Component
17. public class JwtUtil {
18.     
19.     @Value("${jwt.secret}")
20.     private String secret;
21.     
22.     @Value("${jwt.expiration}")
23.     private Long expiration;
24.     
25.     private SecretKey getSigningKey() {
26.         return Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.getBytes());
27.     }
28.     
29.     public String extractUsername(String token) {
30.         return extractClaim(token, Claims::getSubject);
31.     }
32.     
33.     public Date extractExpiration(String token) {
34.         return extractClaim(token, Claims::getExpiration);
35.     }
36.     
37.     public <T> T extractClaim(String token, Function<Claims, T> claimsResolver) {
38.         final Claims claims = extractAllClaims(token);
39.         return claimsResolver.apply(claims);
40.     }
41.     
42.     private Claims extractAllClaims(String token) {
43.         return Jwts.parser()
44.                 .verifyWith(getSigningKey())
45.                 .build()
46.                 .parseSignedClaims(token)
47.                 .getPayload();
48.     }
49.     
50.     private Boolean isTokenExpired(String token) {
51.         return extractExpiration(token).before(new Date());
52.     }
53.     
54.     public String generateToken(UserDetails userDetails) {
55.         Map<String, Object> claims = new HashMap<>();
56.         return createToken(claims, userDetails.getUsername());
57.     }
58.     
59.     private String createToken(Map<String, Object> claims, String subject) {
60.         return Jwts.builder()
61.                 .claims(claims)
62.                 .subject(subject)
63.                 .issuedAt(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis()))
64.                 .expiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + expiration))
65.                 .signWith(getSigningKey())
66.                 .compact();
67.     }
68.     
69.     public Boolean validateToken(String token, UserDetails userDetails) {
70.         final String username = extractUsername(token);
71.         return (username.equals(userDetails.getUsername()) && !isTokenExpired(token));
72.     }
73. }
74.

1. package com.mekongsaltlab.org.security;
2. 
3. import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
4. import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
5. import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
6. import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
7. import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
8. import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
9. import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
10. import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
11. import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
12. import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;
13. import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
14. import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
15. 
16. import java.io.IOException;
17. 
18. @Component
19. @RequiredArgsConstructor
20. public class JwtAuthenticationFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
21.     
22.     private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
23.     private final UserDetailsService userDetailsService;
24.     
25.     @Override
26.     protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, FilterChain filterChain)
27.             throws ServletException, IOException {
28.         
29.         final String authHeader = request.getHeader("Authorization");
30.         
31.         if (authHeader == null || !authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
32.             filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
33.             return;
34.         }
35.         
36.         try {
37.             final String jwt = authHeader.substring(7);
38.             final String username = jwtUtil.extractUsername(jwt);
39.             
40.             if (username != null && SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication() == null) {
41.                 UserDetails userDetails = userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(username);
42.                 
43.                 if (jwtUtil.validateToken(jwt, userDetails)) {
44.                     UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authToken = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
45.                             userDetails, null, userDetails.getAuthorities());
46.                     authToken.setDetails(new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource().buildDetails(request));
47.                     SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(authToken);
48.                 }
49.             }
50.         } catch (Exception e) {
51.             logger.error("Cannot set user authentication: {}", e);
52.         }
53.         
54.         filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
55.     }
56. }
57.

24.   role: string;
25. }

27. const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8084/api';
28. 
29. class AuthService {
30.   private readonly STORAGE_KEY = 'auth';
31. 
32.   async login(data: LoginRequest): Promise<AuthResponse> {
33.     const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/login`, {
34.       method: 'POST',
35.       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
36.       body: JSON.stringify(data),
37.     });
38.     
39.     if (!response.ok) {
40.       const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Login failed' }));
41.       throw new Error(error.error || 'Invalid username or password');
42.     }
43.     
44.     return response.json();
45.   }
46. 
47.   async register(data: RegisterRequest): Promise<AuthResponse> {
48.     const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/register`, {
49.       method: 'POST',
50.       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
51.       body: JSON.stringify(data),
52.     });
53.     
54.     if (!response.ok) {
55.       const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Registration failed' }));
56.       throw new Error(error.error || 'Registration failed');
57.     }
58.     
59.     return response.json();
60.   }
61. 
62.   saveAuth(auth: AuthResponse): void {
63.     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
64.     localStorage.setItem(this.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(auth));
65.   }
66. 
67.   getAuth(): AuthResponse | null {
68.     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
69.     try {
70.       const auth = localStorage.getItem(this.STORAGE_KEY);
71.       return auth ? JSON.parse(auth) : null;
72.     } catch {
73.       return null;
74.     }
75.   }
76. 
77.   logout(): void {
78.     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
79.     localStorage.removeItem(this.STORAGE_KEY);
80.   }
81. 
82.   isAuthenticated(): boolean {
83.     return !!this.getAuth();
84.   }
85. 
86.   hasRole(role: string): boolean {
87.     const auth = this.getAuth();
88.     return auth?.role === role;
89.   }
90. 
91.   getToken(): string | null {
92.     return this.getAuth()?.token || null;
93.   }
94. 
95.   // Verify token is still valid by checking expiration
96.   isTokenValid(): boolean {
97.     const token = this.getToken();
98.     if (!token) return false;
99. 
100.     try {
101.       const payload = JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1]));
102.       const exp = payload.exp * 1000; // Convert to milliseconds
103.       return Date.now() < exp;
104.     } catch {
105.       return false;
106.     }
107.   }
108. 
109.   // Check if user has required role and token is valid
110.   canAccess(requiredRole?: string): boolean {
111.     if (!this.isAuthenticated()) return false;
112.     if (!this.isTokenValid()) {
113.       this.logout();
114.       return false;
115.     }
116.     if (requiredRole && !this.hasRole(requiredRole)) return false;
117.     return true;
118.   }
119. }
120.

122.

1. 'use client';
2. 
3. import { useEffect } from 'react';
4. import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
5. import { authService } from '../../lib/auth';
6. 
7. export function withAuth<P extends object>(
8.   Component: React.ComponentType<P>,
9.   requiredRole?: string
10. ) {
11.   return function AuthenticatedComponent(props: P) {
12.     const router = useRouter();
13. 
14.     useEffect(() => {
15.       // Check authentication
16.       if (!authService.isAuthenticated()) {
17.         router.replace('/auth');
18.         return;
19.       }
20. 
21.       // Check token validity
22.       if (!authService.isTokenValid()) {
23.         authService.logout();
24.         router.replace('/auth');
25.         return;
26.       }
27. 
28.       // Check role if required
29.       if (requiredRole && !authService.hasRole(requiredRole)) {
30.         router.replace('/unauthorized');
31.         return;
32.       }
33.     }, [router]);
34. 
35.     // Only render if authenticated and authorized
36.     if (!authService.canAccess(requiredRole)) {
37.       return null;
38.     }
39. 
40.     return <Component {...props} />;
41.   };
42. }
43.

1. import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
2. import { pool } from '../../../lib/db';
3. import { normalizeDataSource } from '../../../lib/constants/data-sources';
4. import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
5. 
6. export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
7.   try {
8.     // Check authentication from localStorage (passed via header or cookie)
9.     const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization');
10.     const authCookie = cookies().get('auth');
11.     
12.     let isAuthenticated = false;
13.     let hasDataManagerRole = false;
14.     
15.     // Check from Authorization header (for API calls)
16.     if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
17.       const token = authHeader.substring(7);
18.       try {
19.         // Decode JWT to check role (simple check, not full validation)
20.         const payload = JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1]));
21.         const exp = payload.exp * 1000;
22.         
23.         if (Date.now() < exp) {
24.           isAuthenticated = true;
25.           // Check if user has DATA_MANAGER role by calling backend
26.           const backendUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8084/api';
27.           const verifyResponse = await fetch(`${backendUrl}/data`, {
28.             headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
29.           });
30.           hasDataManagerRole = verifyResponse.ok;
31.         }
32.       } catch (e) {
33.         // Invalid token
34.       }
35.     }
36.     
37.     // If not authenticated or no DATA_MANAGER role, deny access
38.     if (!isAuthenticated || !hasDataManagerRole) {
39.       return NextResponse.json(
40.         { error: 'Unauthorized. DATA_MANAGER role required.' }, 
41.         { status: 403 }
42.       );
43.     }
44.     
45.     const sourceParam = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('source');
46.     const dateParam = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('date');
47.     const source = normalizeDataSource(sourceParam);
48.     const tableName = source === 'ecowitt' ? 'ecowitt' : 'mekong';
49.     
50.     // For Mekong: Get latest record per sensor (by SensorNodeCode)
51.     // For Ecowitt: Get latest records by time
52.     let query = '';
53.     let queryParams: string[] = [];
54.     
55.     if (source === 'mekong') {
56.       const dateFilterSql = dateParam ? 'WHERE DATE(m.fetched_at) = ?' : '';
57. 
58.       query = `
59.         SELECT
60.           sensor.id,
61.           sensor._id,
62.           sensor.SensorNodeCode,
63.           sensor.Longitude,
64.           sensor.Latitude,
65.           sensor.ProvinceName,
66.           sensor.ProvinceCode,
67.           sensor.SNShortName,
68.           sensor.SNDescription,
69.           sensor.SNShortNameEN,
70.           sensor.SNDescriptionEN,
71.           sensor.SerialNumber,
72.           sensor.NameLine_1,
73.           sensor.NameLine_2,
74.           sensor.source,
75.           sensor.first_seen_at,
76.           sensor.last_seen_at,
77.           sensor.is_active,
78.           sensor.inactive_at,
79.           DATE_FORMAT(measurement.fetched_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS fetched_at,
80.           measurement.fetch_run_id,
81.           measurement.record_index,
82.           measurement.Salinity,
83.           measurement.PH,
84.           measurement.WaterLevel,
85.           measurement.Alkalinity
86.         FROM mekong_sensor sensor
87.         INNER JOIN (
88.           SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.sensor_code ORDER BY m.fetched_at DESC, m.id DESC) AS rn
89.           FROM mekong_measurement m
90.           ${dateFilterSql}
91.         ) measurement ON measurement.sensor_code = sensor.SensorNodeCode AND measurement.rn = 1
92.         ORDER BY measurement.fetched_at DESC, sensor.SensorNodeCode
93.       `;
94. 
95.       queryParams = dateParam ? [dateParam] : [];
96.     } else {
97.       // Ecowitt: Get latest 100 records
98.       query = `SELECT * FROM \`${tableName}\` ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 100`;
99.     }
100.     
101.     const [rows] = await pool.query(query, queryParams);
102.     
103.     return NextResponse.json({
104.       source,
105.       data: rows
106.     });
107.   } catch (error) {
108.     console.error('Database fetch error:', error);
109.     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Database fetch failed', data: [] }, { status: 500 });
110.   }
111. }
112.
```

1. import { spawn } from 'child_process';
2. import { resolve } from 'path';
3. import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
4. import { normalizeDataSource } from '../../../lib/constants/data-sources';
5. 
6. async function runFetch(request: NextRequest) {
7.   try {
8.     const source = normalizeDataSource(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('source'));
9.     
10.     const scriptMap: Record<string, string> = {
11.       mekong: resolve(process.cwd(), '../datacenter/mekong/fetch-mekong-data.mjs'),
12.       ecowitt: resolve(process.cwd(), '../datacenter/ecowitt/fetch-ecowitt-data.mjs'),
13.     };
14. 
15.     const fetchScript = scriptMap[source];
16.     if (!fetchScript) {
17.       return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Invalid data source' }, { status: 400 });
18.     }
19. 
20.     // Run fetch script (saves directly to MySQL)
21.     const result = await new Promise<{ recordCount: number; insertedRows: number }>((resolve, reject) => {
22.       const fetchProcess = spawn('node', [fetchScript], {
23.         cwd: process.cwd(),
24.         stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe']
25.       });
26.       
27.       let stdout = '';
28.       let stderr = '';
29.       
30.       fetchProcess.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
31.         stdout += data.toString();
32.       });
33.       
34.       fetchProcess.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
35.         stderr += data.toString();
36.       });
37.       
38.       fetchProcess.on('close', (code) => {
39.         if (code === 0) {
40.           try {
41.             const parsed = JSON.parse(stdout);
42.             resolve({ recordCount: parsed.recordCount || 0, insertedRows: parsed.insertedRows || 0 });
43.           } catch {
44.             resolve({ recordCount: 0, insertedRows: 0 });
45.           }
46.         } else {
47.           reject(new Error(`Fetch failed: ${stderr || stdout}`));
48.         }
49.       });
50.     });
51. 
52.     return NextResponse.json({ 
53.       message: `Đã cập nhật ${result.insertedRows} bản ghi vào database`,
54.       source,
55.       recordCount: result.recordCount,
56.       insertedRows: result.insertedRows,
57.       timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')
58.     });
59.   } catch (error) {
60.     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
61.     return NextResponse.json({ 
62.       message: 'Lỗi khi lấy dữ liệu: ' + message
63.     }, { status: 500 });
64.   }
65. }
66. 
67. export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
68.   return runFetch(request);
69. }
70. 
71. export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
72.   return runFetch(request);
73. }
74.
```

</details>

3. import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

7. export function AuthGuard({ children, requiredRole }: { children: React.ReactNode; requiredRole?: string }) {
8.   const router = useRouter();
9.   const pathname = usePathname();
10.   const [isAuthorized, setIsAuthorized] = useState(false);
11.   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
12. 
13.   useEffect(() => {
14.     const checkAuth = () => {
15.       const isAuthenticated = authService.isAuthenticated();
16.       
17.       if (!isAuthenticated) {
18.         router.push('/auth');
19.         return;
20.       }
21. 
22.       if (requiredRole && !authService.hasRole(requiredRole)) {
23.         router.push('/unauthorized');
24.         return;
25.       }
26. 
27.       setIsAuthorized(true);
28.       setIsLoading(false);
29.     };
30. 
31.     checkAuth();
32.   }, [pathname, router, requiredRole]);
33. 
34.   if (isLoading) {
35.     return (
36.       <div style={{
37.         display: 'flex',
38.         alignItems: 'center',
39.         justifyContent: 'center',
40.         minHeight: '100vh',
41.         fontSize: '18px',
42.         color: '#64748b'
43.       }}>
44.         Đang kiểm tra quyền truy cập...
45.       </div>
46.     );
47.   }
48. 
49.   if (!isAuthorized) {
50.     return null;
51.   }
52. 
53.   return <>{children}</>;
54. }

<sub>⏱️ 1m 10s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Mình đã đọc và nắm được tổng thể repo.

**Tóm tắt kiến trúc**
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 + React 19 + OpenLayers 10 + TypeScript, chạy cổng **3004**.
- **Backend**: Spring Boot 4, JPA, Security, JWT, S3 backup, chạy cổng **8084**.
- **Datacenter**: Node.js scripts lấy dữ liệu từ **Mekong API** và **Ecowitt API**, đẩy vào MySQL và xuất CSV snapshot.
- **DB**: MySQL `mekong`.

**Luồng chính**
- Frontend có trang công khai bản đồ + tìm kiếm, trang auth, trang data, dashboard nội bộ.
- Auth dùng JWT lưu ở `localStorage`; frontend tự guard route theo role.
- Backend cung cấp `/api/auth/*`, `/api/data`, `/api/s3/*`, `/api/backup/trigger`.
- Datacenter scripts tự login/lấy dữ liệu rồi sync vào MySQL; frontend có API routes để đọc MySQL và kích hoạt fetch script.

**Điểm đáng chú ý**
- Có **hardcoded credentials/secrets** trong một số file config/script; repo này nên được xem là nhạy cảm.
- Backend có seed user mặc định cho `USER`, `DATA_MANAGER`, `ADMIN`.
- Backup MySQL được nén `.sql.gz` và upload lên S3 theo lịch.

Nếu cần, mình có thể đi tiếp theo kiểu: **vẽ sơ đồ luồng dữ liệu**, **giải thích từng module**, hoặc **chỉ ra các rủi ro/bug chính trong repo**.

1. import { readFile } from 'fs/promises';
2. import { resolve } from 'path';
3. import { stat } from 'fs/promises';
4. import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
5. import { getDataSourceOption, inferDataSourceFromFilename, normalizeDataSource } from '../../../../lib/constants/data-sources';
6. 
7. function formatTimestampForFilename(date: Date) {
8.   const year = date.getFullYear();
9.   const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
10.   const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
11.   const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
12.   const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
13.   const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
14. 
15.   return `${year}${month}${day}-${hours}${minutes}${seconds}`;
16. }
17. 
18. export async function GET(
19.   request: NextRequest,
20.   { params }: { params: Promise<{ filename: string }> }
21. ) {
22.   try {
23.     const { filename } = await params;
24.     const source = normalizeDataSource(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('source') ?? inferDataSourceFromFilename(filename));
25.     const config = getDataSourceOption(source);
26.     const dataDir = resolve(process.cwd(), config.outputFolder);
27.     const filePath = resolve(dataDir, filename);
28.     const fileStat = await stat(filePath);
29.     const content = await readFile(filePath);
30.     const extensionIndex = filename.lastIndexOf('.');
31.     const baseName = extensionIndex >= 0 ? filename.slice(0, extensionIndex) : filename;
32.     const extension = extensionIndex >= 0 ? filename.slice(extensionIndex) : '';
33.     const timestampedFilename = `${baseName}_${formatTimestampForFilename(fileStat.mtime)}${extension}`;
34.     const normalizedExtension = extension.toLowerCase();
35.     const contentType = normalizedExtension === '.xlsx'
36.       ? 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
37.       : normalizedExtension === '.csv'
38.         ? 'text/csv'
39.         : 'application/octet-stream';
40.     
41.     return new NextResponse(content, {
42.       headers: {
43.         'Content-Type': contentType,
44.         'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${timestampedFilename}"`
45.       }
46.     });
47.   } catch (error) {
48.     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'File not found' }, { status: 404 });
49.   }
50. }
51.
```

</details>

1. import { spawn } from 'child_process';
2. import { resolve } from 'path';
3. import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
4. 
5. async function runUpdate() {
6.   const repoRoot = resolve(process.cwd(), '..');
7.   const scriptPath = resolve(repoRoot, 'data/mekong/scripts/update-mekong-monthly-xlsx.mjs');
8. 
9.   await new Promise<void>((resolvePromise, reject) => {
10.     const child = spawn('node', [scriptPath], {
11.       cwd: repoRoot,
12.       stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
13.     });
14. 
15.     let stdout = '';
16.     let stderr = '';
17. 
18.     child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => {
19.       stdout += chunk.toString();
20.     });
21. 
22.     child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => {
23.       stderr += chunk.toString();
24.     });
25. 
26.     child.on('close', (code) => {
27.       if (code === 0) {
28.         resolvePromise();
29.         return;
30.       }
31. 
32.       reject(new Error(stderr.trim() || stdout.trim() || `Update failed with code ${code}`));
33.     });
34.   });
35. }
36. 
37. export async function POST() {
38.   try {
39.     await runUpdate();
40.     return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Đã cập nhật file Excel theo tháng.' });
41.   } catch (error) {
42.     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
43.     return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Lỗi khi cập nhật: ' + message }, { status: 500 });
44.   }
45. }
46.

1. import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
2. import mysql from 'mysql2/promise';
3. import proj4 from 'proj4';
4. import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
5. 
6. const MYSQL_CONFIG = {
7.   host: process.env.MYSQL_HOST || '127.0.0.1',
8.   port: Number(process.env.MYSQL_PORT || '3306'),
9.   user: process.env.MYSQL_USER || 'root',
10.   password: process.env.MYSQL_PASSWORD || '1111',
11.   database: process.env.MYSQL_DATABASE || 'mekong',
12. };
13. 
14. const METRICS = [
15.   { key: 'Salinity', label: 'Độ mặn', slug: 'salinity' },
16.   { key: 'PH', label: 'pH', slug: 'ph' },
17.   { key: 'WaterLevel', label: 'Mực nước', slug: 'waterlevel' },
18. ];
19. 
20. const UTM48_EPSG = 'EPSG:32648';
21. 
22. if (!proj4.defs(UTM48_EPSG)) {
23.   proj4.defs(UTM48_EPSG, '+proj=utm +zone=48 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs');
24. }
25. 
26. function toUtm48(longitude: unknown, latitude: unknown) {
27.   const lon = Number(longitude);
28.   const lat = Number(latitude);
29. 
30.   if (!Number.isFinite(lon) || !Number.isFinite(lat)) {
31.     return null;
32.   }
33. 
34.   const [x, y] = proj4('EPSG:4326', UTM48_EPSG, [lon, lat]);
35.   return { x, y };
36. }
37. 
38. function buildDayColumns(year: number, month: number) {
39.   const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
40.   return Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => {
41.     const day = String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
42.     return `${day}/${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}`;
43.   });
44. }
45. 
46. function formatMetricValue(value: unknown) {
47.   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
48.     return '';
49.   }
50. 
51.   const normalizedText = String(value).trim().replace(',', '.');
52.   if (/^0+(?:\.0+)?$/.test(normalizedText)) {
53.     return '';
54.   }
55. 
56.   const numericValue = Number(normalizedText);
57.   if (!Number.isFinite(numericValue)) {
58.     return value;
59.   }
60. 
61.   return numericValue.toFixed(2);
62. }
63. 
64. export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
65.   try {
66.     const { searchParams } = request.nextUrl;
67.     const year = Number(searchParams.get('year')) || new Date().getFullYear();
68.     const month = Number(searchParams.get('month')) || new Date().getMonth() + 1;
69.     const metric = searchParams.get('metric') || 'salinity';
70. 
71.     const metricConfig = METRICS.find(m => m.slug === metric);
72.     if (!metricConfig) {
73.       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid metric' }, { status: 400 });
74.     }
75. 
76.     const connection = await mysql.createConnection(MYSQL_CONFIG);
77. 
78.     // Query data for the month
79.     const startDate = `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-01 00:00:00`;
80.     const endDate = `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${new Date(year, month, 0).getDate()} 23:59:59`;
81. 
82.     const [rows] = await connection.query<any[]>(
83.       `SELECT 
84.         s.SensorNodeCode, s.SNShortName, s.ProvinceName, s.Longitude, s.Latitude,
85.         m.${metricConfig.key}, DATE_FORMAT(m.fetched_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS fetched_at
86.       FROM mekong_measurement m
87.       INNER JOIN mekong_sensor s ON s.SensorNodeCode = m.sensor_code
88.       WHERE m.fetched_at BETWEEN ? AND ?
89.       ORDER BY s.SensorNodeCode, m.fetched_at, m.id`,
90.       [startDate, endDate]
91.     );
92. 
93.     await connection.end();
94. 
95.     // Build Excel structure
96.     const BASE_COLUMNS = ['ID', 'Address', 'X', 'Y'];
97.     const dayColumns = buildDayColumns(year, month);
98.     const allColumns = [...BASE_COLUMNS, ...dayColumns];
99. 
100.     // Group by sensor
101.     const sensorMap = new Map<string, any>();
102.     
103.     for (const row of rows) {
104.       const sensorCode = row.SensorNodeCode || row.SerialNumber || 'UNKNOWN';
105.       
106.       if (!sensorMap.has(sensorCode)) {
107.         const utm = toUtm48(row.Longitude, row.Latitude);
108.         sensorMap.set(sensorCode, {
109.           ID: sensorCode,
110.           Address: row.SNShortName || row.SNDescription || sensorCode,
111.           X: utm ? utm.x : '',
112.           Y: utm ? utm.y : '',
113.         });
114.       }
115. 
116.       // Add value to corresponding day column
117.       if (row.fetched_at) {
118.         const fetchedAt = String(row.fetched_at);
119.         const day = fetchedAt.slice(8, 10);
120.         const dayCol = `${day}/${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}`;
121.         
122.         if (dayColumns.includes(dayCol)) {
123.           const sensor = sensorMap.get(sensorCode)!;
124.           sensor[dayCol] = formatMetricValue(row[metricConfig.key]);
125.         }
126.       }
127.     }
128. 
129.     // Convert to array and fill missing columns
130.     const data = Array.from(sensorMap.values()).map(sensor => {
131.       const row: any = {};
132.       for (const col of allColumns) {
133.         row[col] = sensor[col] || '';
134.       }
135.       return row;
136.     });
137. 
138.     // Create workbook
139.     const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(data, { header: allColumns });
140.     const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
141.     XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, metricConfig.label);
142. 
143.     // Generate buffer
144.     const buffer = XLSX.write(wb, { type: 'buffer', bookType: 'xlsx' });
145. 
146.     // Return file
147.     const filename = `mekong-${metric}-${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}.xlsx`;
148.     
149.     return new NextResponse(buffer, {
150.       headers: {
151.         'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
152.         'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
153.       },
154.     });
155.   } catch (error) {
156.     console.error('Export error:', error);
157.     return NextResponse.json({ 
158.       error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Export failed' 
159.     }, { status: 500 });
160.   }
161. }
162.
```

<sub>⏱️ 3m 2s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Mình đã đọc kỹ luồng **FE + BE + datacenter lấy dữ liệu**. Tóm gọn:

**1. Datacenter là nơi kéo dữ liệu gốc**
- `datacenter/mekong/fetch-mekong-data.mjs`: login Mekong API bằng payload cố định, lấy token, gọi endpoint dữ liệu, rồi:
  - tạo rows cho `mekong_sensor`
  - tạo rows cho `mekong_measurement`
  - upsert/sync vào MySQL
  - ghi CSV snapshot
- `datacenter/ecowitt/fetch-ecowitt-data.mjs`: login/bootstrap cookie Ecowitt, gọi `get_data`, rồi:
  - build rows theo thời gian + series
  - sync vào MySQL
  - ghi CSV snapshot
  - nếu có `--output` thì ghi thêm JSON

**2. Frontend không kéo trực tiếp từ API gốc**
- FE đọc từ:
  - **MySQL** qua route `src/app/api/mysql/route.ts`
  - **file output** qua `api/files`, `api/data/[filename]`, `api/download/[filename]`
  - **Excel monthly** qua `api/mekong-monthly/*`
- `api/fetch` là route đặc biệt: nó **spawn node script datacenter** để chạy fetch lại dữ liệu, rồi script tự đẩy DB.

**3. Luồng dữ liệu end-to-end**
- FE gọi `api/fetch`
- route này chạy script datacenter tương ứng
- script lấy dữ liệu từ Mekong/Ecowitt
- script ghi vào MySQL + file output
- FE đọc dữ liệu từ MySQL hoặc từ file output để hiển thị/browse/export

**4. Backend Spring Boot**
- Có auth JWT + role:
  - `USER`
  - `DATA_MANAGER`
  - `ADMIN`
- `/api/data` chỉ cho `DATA_MANAGER`
- `/api/s3/*` upload/download/list/delete file trên S3-compatible storage
- `/api/backup/trigger` backup MySQL lên S3
- `DataInit` tạo sẵn 3 user mặc định
- `SecurityConfig` cho phép auth endpoints, swagger, và chặn data endpoint theo role

**5. FE structure**
- `/(public)`:
  - trang chủ map
  - auth
  - data
- `/(dashboard)`:
  - khu vực nội bộ
- Có guard client-side bằng `localStorage` token
- `src/lib/auth.ts` tự decode JWT để check hạn và role

**6. Điểm đáng chú ý**
- Repo đang có **hardcoded credentials/config** ở vài file datacenter/backend config.
- FE auth chủ yếu dựa vào `localStorage`, nên phần client-side chỉ là lớp UX; phần kiểm soát thật nằm ở backend/API route.
- `api/mysql` vừa kiểm tra token vừa gọi backend `/api/data` để xác nhận role `DATA_MANAGER` trước khi query DB.

Nếu cần, mình có thể tiếp tục làm một bản **sơ đồ luồng dữ liệu chi tiết theo file**, hoặc **đi sâu từng route/API**.

<sub>⏱️ 4m 28s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

**S3 trong backend** là lớp lưu trữ file dùng cho **upload / download / list / delete** và **backup MySQL**.

**Cấu hình**
- `S3Config` tạo `S3Client` bằng:
  - `s3.endpoint`
  - `s3.access-key`
  - `s3.secret-key`
  - `s3.region`
- Client dùng `forcePathStyle(true)` để làm việc với S3-compatible endpoint riêng.

**Service**
- `S3Service` là lớp thao tác chính:
  - `uploadFile(MultipartFile file)` → tự sinh key kiểu `uploads/yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_filename`
  - `uploadFile(String key, MultipartFile file)` → upload theo key chỉ định
  - `uploadFile(String key, InputStream, contentLength)` → dùng cho backup
  - `downloadFile(key)`
  - `deleteFile(key)`
  - `listFiles(prefix)`
  - `fileExists(key)`
  - `getFileUrl(key)` → dựng URL public từ bucket

**API**
- `POST /api/s3/upload` → upload file
- `GET /api/s3/download/{key}` → tải file
- `GET /api/s3/list?prefix=...` → liệt kê file
- `DELETE /api/s3/delete/{key}` → xoá file
- `GET /api/s3/exists/{key}` → kiểm tra tồn tại

**Phân quyền**
- `ADMIN` và `DATA_MANAGER`: upload/delete
- user đã đăng nhập: download/list/exists

**Backup**
- `BackupService` dùng `S3Service` để:
  1. chạy `mysqldump`
  2. nén `.sql.gz`
  3. upload lên S3 với key dạng `backups/mysql/...`
- `POST /api/backup/trigger` gọi backup thủ công.

**Lưu ý**
- Cấu hình S3 đang nằm trong `application.yaml`; nên chuyển sang biến môi trường nếu deploy thật.
- `getFileUrl()` đang ghép URL cố định theo endpoint public, nên chỉ đúng với storage đang dùng hiện tại.

1. import { spawn } from 'child_process';
2. import { resolve } from 'path';
3. import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
4. import { normalizeDataSource } from '../../../lib/constants/data-sources';
5. 
6. async function runFetch(request: NextRequest) {
7.   try {
8.     const source = normalizeDataSource(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('source'));
9.     
10.     const scriptMap: Record<string, string> = {
11.       mekong: resolve(process.cwd(), '../datacenter/mekong/fetch-mekong-data.mjs'),
12.       ecowitt: resolve(process.cwd(), '../datacenter/ecowitt/fetch-ecowitt-data.mjs'),
13.     };
14. 
15.     const fetchScript = scriptMap[source];
16.     if (!fetchScript) {
17.       return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Invalid data source' }, { status: 400 });
18.     }
19. 
20.     // Run fetch script (saves directly to MySQL)
21.     const result = await new Promise<{ recordCount: number; insertedRows: number }>((resolve, reject) => {
22.       const fetchProcess = spawn('node', [fetchScript], {
23.         cwd: process.cwd(),
24.         stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe']
25.       });
26.       
27.       let stdout = '';
28.       let stderr = '';
29.       
30.       fetchProcess.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
31.         stdout += data.toString();
32.       });
33.       
34.       fetchProcess.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
35.         stderr += data.toString();
36.       });
37.       
38.       fetchProcess.on('close', (code) => {
39.         if (code === 0) {
40.           try {
41.             const parsed = JSON.parse(stdout);
42.             resolve({ recordCount: parsed.recordCount || 0, insertedRows: parsed.insertedRows || 0 });
43.           } catch {
44.             resolve({ recordCount: 0, insertedRows: 0 });
45.           }
46.         } else {
47.           reject(new Error(`Fetch failed: ${stderr || stdout}`));
48.         }
49.       });
50.     });
51. 
52.     return NextResponse.json({ 
53.       message: `Đã cập nhật ${result.insertedRows} bản ghi vào database`,
54.       source,
55.       recordCount: result.recordCount,
56.       insertedRows: result.insertedRows,
57.       timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')
58.     });
59.   } catch (error) {
60.     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
61.     return NextResponse.json({ 
62.       message: 'Lỗi khi lấy dữ liệu: ' + message
63.     }, { status: 500 });
64.   }
65. }
66. 
67. export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
68.   return runFetch(request);
69. }
70. 
71. export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
72.   return runFetch(request);
73. }
74.
```

9. 
10.     const sourceParam = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('source');

14. 
15.     let query = '';
16.     let queryParams: string[] = [];
17. 
18.     if (source === 'mekong') {
19.       const dateFilterSql = dateParam ? 'WHERE DATE(m.fetched_at) = ?' : '';
20. 
21.       query = `
22.         SELECT
23.           sensor.id,
24.           sensor._id,
25.           sensor.SensorNodeCode,
26.           sensor.Longitude,
27.           sensor.Latitude,
28.           sensor.ProvinceName,
29.           sensor.ProvinceCode,
30.           sensor.SNShortName,
31.           sensor.SNDescription,
32.           sensor.SNShortNameEN,
33.           sensor.SNDescriptionEN,
34.           sensor.SerialNumber,
35.           sensor.NameLine_1,
36.           sensor.NameLine_2,
37.           sensor.source,
38.           sensor.first_seen_at,
39.           sensor.last_seen_at,
40.           sensor.is_active,
41.           sensor.inactive_at,
42.           DATE_FORMAT(measurement.fetched_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS fetched_at,
43.           measurement.fetch_run_id,
44.           measurement.record_index,
45.           measurement.Salinity,
46.           measurement.PH,
47.           measurement.WaterLevel,
48.           measurement.Alkalinity
49.         FROM mekong_sensor sensor
50.         INNER JOIN (
51.           SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.sensor_code ORDER BY m.fetched_at DESC, m.id DESC) AS rn
52.           FROM mekong_measurement m
53.           ${dateFilterSql}
54.         ) measurement ON measurement.sensor_code = sensor.SensorNodeCode AND measurement.rn = 1
55.         ORDER BY measurement.fetched_at DESC, sensor.SensorNodeCode
56.       `;
57. 
58.       queryParams = dateParam ? [dateParam] : [];
59.     } else {
60.       query = `SELECT * FROM \`${tableName}\` ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 100`;
61.     }
62.

1. import { spawn } from 'child_process';
2. import { resolve } from 'path';
3. import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
4. import { normalizeDataSource } from '../../../lib/constants/data-sources';
5. import { requireRoleFromRequest } from '../../../lib/server-auth';
6. 
7. async function runFetch(request: NextRequest) {
8.   try {
9.     await requireRoleFromRequest(request, ['DATA_MANAGER', 'ADMIN']);
10. 
11.     const source = normalizeDataSource(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('source'));
12.     
13.     const scriptMap: Record<string, string> = {
14.       mekong: resolve(process.cwd(), '../datacenter/mekong/fetch-mekong-data.mjs'),
15.       ecowitt: resolve(process.cwd(), '../datacenter/ecowitt/fetch-ecowitt-data.mjs'),
16.     };
17. 
18.     const fetchScript = scriptMap[source];
19.     if (!fetchScript) {
20.       return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Invalid data source' }, { status: 400 });
21.     }
22. 
23.     // Run fetch script (saves directly to MySQL)
24.     const result = await new Promise<{ recordCount: number; insertedRows: number }>((resolve, reject) => {
25.       const fetchProcess = spawn('node', [fetchScript], {
26.         cwd: process.cwd(),
27.         stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe']
28.       });
29.       
30.       let stdout = '';
31.       let stderr = '';
32.       
33.       fetchProcess.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
34.         stdout += data.toString();
35.       });
36.       
37.       fetchProcess.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
38.         stderr += data.toString();
39.       });
40.       
41.       fetchProcess.on('close', (code) => {
42.         if (code === 0) {
43.           try {
44.             const parsed = JSON.parse(stdout);
45.             resolve({ recordCount: parsed.recordCount || 0, insertedRows: parsed.insertedRows || 0 });
46.           } catch {
47.             resolve({ recordCount: 0, insertedRows: 0 });
48.           }
49.         } else {
50.           reject(new Error(`Fetch failed: ${stderr || stdout}`));
51.         }
52.       });
53.     });
54. 
55.     return NextResponse.json({ 
56.       message: `Đã cập nhật ${result.insertedRows} bản ghi vào database`,
57.       source,
58.       recordCount: result.recordCount,
59.       insertedRows: result.insertedRows,
60.       timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')
61.     });
62.   } catch (error) {
63.     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
64.     if (message === 'Unauthorized') {
65.       return NextResponse.json({ 
66.         message: 'Unauthorized. DATA_MANAGER or ADMIN role required.' 
67.       }, { status: 403 });
68.     }
69.     return NextResponse.json({ 
70.       message: 'Lỗi khi lấy dữ liệu: ' + message
71.     }, { status: 500 });
72.   }
73. }
74. 
75. export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
76.   return runFetch(request);
77. }
78. 
79. export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
80.   return runFetch(request);
81. }

57.   }
58.

60.

64.   }

68.     pickRecordArray(maybeData?.rows),
69.     pickRecordArray(maybeData?.list),
70.     pickRecordArray(maybeData?.records),

75.   ];

80.     }

82. 
83.   return [];
84. }

86. export function collectRecordKeys(records: DataRecord[]): string[] {
87.   const keySet = new Set<string>();
88. 
89.   for (const record of records) {
90.     for (const key of Object.keys(record)) {
91.       keySet.add(key);
92.     }
93.   }
94. 
95.   return Array.from(keySet);
96. }

98. export function formatRecordValue(value: unknown): string {
99.   if (value === null || value === undefined) {
100.     return '';
101.   }
102. 
103.   if (typeof value === 'string') {
104.     return value;
105.   }
106. 
107.   if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') {
108.     return String(value);
109.   }
110. 
111.   try {
112.     return JSON.stringify(value);
113.   } catch {
114.     return String(value);
115.   }
116. }

118. export function recordsToCsv(records: DataRecord[]): string {
119.   if (!records.length) {
120.     return 'No data available';
121.   }
122. 
123.   const headers = collectRecordKeys(records);
124. 
125.   const escapeValue = (value: unknown) => {
126.     const text = formatRecordValue(value);
127. 
128.     if (text.includes(',') || text.includes('"') || text.includes('\n')) {

130.     }
131. 
132.     return text;
133.   };

135.   const rows = records.map((record) => headers.map((header) => escapeValue(record[header])).join(','));
136. 
137.   return [headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\n');

31.         String uploadedKey = key != null && !key.isBlank()
32.                 ? s3Service.uploadFile(key.trim(), file)
33.                 : s3Service.uploadFile(file);
34. 
35.         Map<String, String> response = new HashMap<>();

37.         response.put("url", s3Service.getFileUrl(uploadedKey));
38.         response.put("message", "File uploaded successfully");

40.         return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
41.     }

49.         InputStream inputStream = s3Service.downloadFile(key);
50. 
51.         return ResponseEntity.ok()
52.                 .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION, "attachment; filename=\"" + key + "\"")

55.     }

62.     public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> listFiles(@RequestParam(required = false, defaultValue = "") String prefix) {
63.         try {
64.             List<String> files = s3Service.listFiles(prefix);
65.             
66.             Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
67.             response.put("files", files);
68.             response.put("count", files.size());
69.             
70.             return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
71.         } catch (Exception e) {
72.             Map<String, Object> error = new HashMap<>();

74.             return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(error);
